decisions.decision: Chairman Tyler stated the Commission does not buy back previously sold plots; the owner may donate the lot back or a family member or friend may purchase it (answer to Jeanne Mayo's inquiry).
decisions.quote: chairman, tyler stated that the cemetery commission does not buy back the plots that have been previously sold.

decisions.decision: The Commission will work on a win-win solution for the family regarding the bench placed without permission; the solution will be presented face-to-face.
decisions.quote: the cemetery commission will work on a win-win solution for this family.

decisions.decision: No more certified letters will be sent to individuals; the Rules and Regulations are posted at each cemetery and online.
decisions.quote: there will be no more certified letters being sent to individuals, as the lunenburg cemetery commission - rules and regulations have been posted at each cemetery and on-line.
